claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for leaving hair soft, smooth, and moisturized without weighing it down.
Many reviewers with fine or thin hair report good volume and freshness, with some noting their hair stays clean for multiple days.
Several reviewers complain that the product did not arrive as advertised, missing the box and comb shown in the listing.
Some reviewers mention packaging or shipping issues such as leaks or poor packing.
Reviewers report the product helps with dry, damaged, or color-treated hair and reduces frizz.

qa.q: Is this good for fine, thin hair or will it weigh it down?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate this works well for fine, thin hair without weighing it down: one reviewer with long thin hair that always felt weighed down found it amazing [1], and another with very fine hair described it as volume and moisture without weight [2]. A reviewer with thin wavy hair also reported it kept hair fresh and voluminous into day 3 [4].

claims.text: A reviewer with long thin hair that always felt weighed down found this shampoo and conditioner amazing [1].
A reviewer with very fine hair described it as volume and moisture without weight [2].
A reviewer with thin wavy hair reported it kept hair fresh and voluminous into day 3 [4].

qa.q: Does it help with frizz and flyaways?
qa.answer: One reviewer reports that frizz stays at bay throughout the day with this product [3]. No review directly addresses flyaways.

claims.text: The frizz stays at bay throughout the day.

qa.q: Is it safe for color-treated hair?
qa.answer: Reviews suggest it works well for color-treated hair: one reviewer with long color-treated curly/wavy hair called it amazing [6], and another with overly processed/overly colored hair said it left hair soft as butter [5]. However, no review explicitly confirms color safety, and one reviewer with curly/wavy hair reported their hair felt dry and matted [3].

claims.text: A reviewer with long color-treated layered curly/wavy hair called the product amazing [6].
A reviewer with overly processed/overly colored hair said it left hair soft as butter [5].
One reviewer with curly/wavy hair reported their hair felt dry and matted [3].

qa.q: How does it smell, and is the scent strong?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the scent as a light, pleasant oatmeal scent that isn't overpowering [2], and as pleasant, clean, and fresh [3][6], though one reviewer says it has no scent [5].

claims.text: It has a very light, pleasant, oatmeal scent that is not overpowering.
Hair smells pleasant, clean and fresh.
One reviewer reports there is no scent.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
